Overview

Zabrze is a city in Silesian with a population of 170,557. A historic mining city in Upper Silesia, home to the Queen Luiza coal mine museum and a key center of Poland’s industrial heritage. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
